name: Bexhoma: Benchmark Experiment Host Manager
description: Bexhoma (Benchmark Experiment Host Manager) is a Python tool that manages benchmark experiments of Database Management Systems (DBMS) in Kubernetes clusters. It deploys the systems under test, runs data generators, loaders and benchmark drivers (DBMS-Benchmarker, HammerDB, Benchbase, YCSB) as containers, collects hardware metrics, and evaluates and reports the results, so that experiments can be repeated over varying configurations.
